Using \(\sin^2 x+\cos^2 x=1\):
\[
(\sin\theta+\cos\theta)^2+(\sin\theta\cos\theta)^2=1
\]
\[
1+2\sin\theta\cos\theta+\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta=1
\]
\[
\sin\theta\cos\theta(2+\sin\theta\cos\theta)=0
\]
Since \(\sin\theta\cos\theta\in[-1/2,1/2]\), we get
\[
\sin\theta\cos\theta=0
\]
Thus \(\cos x=0\), so \(\sin^2 x=1\). Therefore
\[
\cos(2x)=\cos^2 x-\sin^2 x=-1
\]
\[
\cos^5(2x)=(-1)^5=-1
\]
\[
\boxed{-1}
\]
